description: This file defines the OrderEntity class, a data model representing an order, including fields like totals, payment details, status, and date, extending the Order class with serialization support.

classes.name: OrderEntity
classes.description: A Java class representing an order entity with various order-related properties, extending Order and implementing Serializable.

methods.name: setTotals
methods.description: Sets the list of totals associated with the order.

methods.name: getTotals
methods.description: Returns the list of totals associated with the order.

methods.name: getPaymentType
methods.description: Retrieves the payment type used for the order.

methods.name: setPaymentType
methods.description: Sets the payment type for the order.

methods.name: getCreditCard
methods.description: Retrieves the credit card information associated with the order.

methods.name: setCreditCard
methods.description: Sets the credit card information for the order.

methods.name: getDatePurchased
methods.description: Gets the date when the order was purchased.

methods.name: setDatePurchased
methods.description: Sets the purchase date for the order.

methods.name: setPreviousOrderStatus
methods.description: Sets the list of previous order statuses.

methods.name: getPreviousOrderStatus
methods.description: Retrieves the list of previous order statuses.

methods.name: getCurrency
methods.description: Returns the currency code associated with the order.

methods.name: setCurrency
methods.description: Sets the currency code for the order.
